text:
alex: Quick sync — planning to enable header-based runtime fallback in the SDK next Tue 09:00 PT. This uses a new header and server-side min_sdk check. Need canary audience + telemetry + rollback guardrails. Any blockers?

maria: +1. what's the exact header format? Will older clients ignore it?

alex: Header example: `X-RW-Feature: runtime_fallback=enabled;min_sdk=2.0.0`. Older clients won't send it; server will treat them as legacy. We'll also parse `min_sdk` server-side to avoid surprising behavior.

eli: Are we bucketing by org or api key? Per-org sounds safer so customers can opt-in.

alex: Plan: hash(api_key) % 100 -> bucket. Canary: bucket 0 (1% orgs) -> bucket 0-9 (10%) -> 25% -> 100%. Global flag + region isolation available for emergency rollback.

sam_devex: Telemetry reqs: emit `feature.runtime_fallback.bucket={bucket}` `sdk_version={version}` and events `fallback_triggered` + `fallback_reason`. Also add a response header so clients can see status.

jen: Guardrails: abort rollout if error_rate > 1.5x baseline OR latency_p95 increases >200ms sustained for 30m. Also auto-roll back if `fallback_triggered` > 3% of requests for 15m.

ci-bot: CI green for feature/runtime-fallback branch — integration tests passed (16m ago): https://ci.example/1234

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled -> infra-canary at 2026-05-12T16:00Z. Runbook link: /runbooks/runtime-fallback-canary.md

maria: One question: do we need an SDK change so clients can optionally echo a header or log it? Old SDKs won't send anything.

alex: We won't require older SDKs to change. Server will treat missing header as "legacy_mode". We will add response header `X-RW-Fallback-Status: active|not_active|legacy` for observability.

eli: Recommend a small SDK patch (2.0.1) that emits `rw.fallback_header_sent` telemetry bool so teams can validate rollout from client-side.

sam_devex: I'll draft the migration note and short FAQ. Suggested FAQ entry: "If my app misbehaves, remove header or flip the global flag; rollback is quick."

alex: Rollout timeline (proposed): 1% (4h), 10% (8h), 25% (12h), 100% (24h). Monitoring: Devtools -> Features -> runtime-fallback; watch errors, p95, fallback rate, and model mismatch counts.

jen: I'll own the rollback playbook and be on-call for the window. Setting alert thresholds now. :white_check_mark:

maria: Can someone open the docs PR for headers+server behavior?

sam_devex: Draft PR created: https://git.example/pr/5678 — will add telemetry schema and the `X-RW-Fallback-Status` header note.

alex: Example header usage for SDK authors: 

```http
# request header example
X-RW-Feature: runtime_fallback=enabled;min_sdk=2.0.0

# server response header for observability
X-RW-Fallback-Status: active
```

alex: Quick checklist for rollout:
- [ ] server feature flag in prod config
- [ ] telemetry events + dashboard updated
- [ ] SDK patch (optional) and release note
- [ ] runbook and rollback playbook linked
- [ ] monitoring alerts configured

eli: Pinged for code review on SDK patch. Will check for backward-compatible parsing and unit tests.

maria: Also recommend we land a lightweight dashboard card that shows per-bucket fallback rate so we can catch regressions early.

sam_devex: Adding that to the dashboard ticket.

ci-bot: Integration tests for canary job queued: https://ci.example/5678 (ETA 12m)

deploy-bot: Canary started -> infra-canary -> 2026-05-12T16:05Z

alex: Reached 10% with no notable regressions after 8h. Continuing rollout tomorrow per plan. Thanks all.

maria: ack. Leaving notes for support teams.

eli: Reviewing SDK PR now.

jen: Rollback playbook finalized and linked in runbook.
